tools.name: command_run
tools.description: Run a bounded diagnostic or maintenance command inside the declared runtime.

tools.name: service_status
tools.description: Read the live service or database health signal.

tools.name: metrics_read
tools.description: Read a bounded live resource metric for diagnosis.

tools.name: service_control
tools.description: Apply one bounded repair supported by the observed live state. Use only after diagnosis.

constraints: Do not read case root, evaluator files, hidden labels, scenario files, host credentials, or Docker sockets.
Tool calls and outputs are recorded in the writable trace directory.
